$comment: Brand and generated assets. Higgsfield entries keep the exact prompt so they can be regenerated or varied. Raw originals live in brand-src/ (git-ignored).

brand.source: brand-src/Logo.png (supplied by the community, 1200x1280 transparent PNG)

brand.notes: Ping-pong (forward + reversed) 10s loop, hue shifted -40deg toward brand green, 8-bit, silent.

higgsfield.retired_reason: Hero rebuilt around the community crest and background loop (2026-10-02). Files removed; kept for the record and prompt reuse.
higgsfield.prompt: A holographic 'network core': a glowing geodesic wireframe sphere (icosahedron lattice of thin luminous lines) floating dead-center, with a faint inner energy glow. Around it, three tilted thin orbital rings carry small bright spherical data nodes, connected to the core by faint dashed light filaments. Colors: neon cyan #00e5ff and neon green #00ff9c light on a pure near-black #05070a background, with a single tiny magenta #ff2bd6 accent node. Soft bloom glow, subtle particle dust, slight depth of field. Sci-fi hacker interface aesthetic, clean, minimal, high contrast. Object fully in frame with generous dark margin on all sides, nothing touching the edges. No text, no letters, no logos, no UI, no people, no floor.

higgsfield.purpose: Default team emblem set (teams.logo_key = emblem:<slug>) until logo uploads arrive in Phase 5
higgsfield.prompt_template: Team emblem badge: <SUBJECT>, drawn as a clean monoline neon emblem, centered inside a circular badge ring. Colors: emerald green #00c46a glowing lines with bone white #f2efe9 highlights and a single signal red #e8192c accent (<ACCENT>), on a solid near-black #05070a background. Flat vector-like esports/cybersecurity crest style, bold readable silhouette that still works at 48 pixels, <symmetrical|balanced> composition, thin double ring border with small tick marks like a targeting reticle, subtle outer glow. Fills most of the frame with a small even margin. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no gradient background, no 3D render, no photorealism.
